auth.note: Authenticate with your BluGate client API key and client code. BluGate handles upstream credentials for you.

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.description: Liveness probe. Returns {"status": "ok"} immediately when the API is up. Does no scraping, so it is the right endpoint for gateway health checks.

endpoints.name: List news sources
endpoints.description: Lists the active news sources (newspapers, TV news, agencies) the API can scrape. Each item has id, name, region, country, state, language, type, base_url and active. Use it to build Country / Language / State / Website filter lists; the id values are what the source filter on /news/articles expects. Returns a plain JSON array. Fast: reads the registry, no scraping. Filters are ANDed with each other; comma-separated values inside one filter are ORed.

params.name: country
params.description: Country name(s), e.g. 'India' or 'India,United States'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: state
params.description: Indian state(s), e.g. 'Telangana' or 'Telangana,Tamil Nadu'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: language
params.description: Language(s), e.g. 'English' or 'English,Telugu'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: source
params.description: Source registry id(s) or name substrings, e.g. 'eenadu' or 'cnn,bbc_news'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

endpoints.name: Search articles
endpoints.description: Filtered, paginated news articles. Returns {count, limit, offset, articles[]}; count is the total before pagination. Each article has id, title, content, summary, source, source_id, source_url, language, country, state, district, location, published_at and image_url. All filters are optional: different filters are ANDed, comma-separated values inside one filter are ORed. Sources are scraped live on first use and then cached for 10 minutes, so a cold request can take 60-90 seconds while a cached one returns in under a second. Set the gateway timeout for this route to at least 120 seconds. No match returns 200 with count 0, not 404.

params.name: keyword
params.description: Keyword to match in the article, e.g. 'drugs', 'corruption', 'accident'.

params.name: country
params.description: Country name(s), e.g. 'India' or 'India,United States'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: language
params.description: Language(s), e.g. 'English' or 'English,Telugu'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: location
params.description: Place name(s) matched against the article's district, location or state, e.g. 'Hyderabad'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: state
params.description: Indian state(s), e.g. 'Telangana' or 'Telangana,Andhra Pradesh'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: district
params.description: District(s), e.g. 'Hyderabad' or 'Hyderabad,Karimnagar'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: source
params.description: Source registry id(s) from /news/sources (preferred) or name substrings, e.g. 'eenadu' or 'cnn,bbc_news'. Comma-separated for multi-select; values are ORed together.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of articles per page. Default 20, minimum 1, maximum 100. Article bodies are large, so prefer small pages.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of articles to skip, for pagination. Default 0, minimum 0.

endpoints.name: Get article by id
endpoints.description: Returns one full article by its id. Only finds articles that are currently cached (articles are cached for 10 minutes after a /news/articles request scrapes their source; there is no database). Returns 404 if the id is not in the cache; call /news/articles again with matching filters, then retry.

params.name: article_id
params.description: Article id, taken from the id field of a /news/articles result.
